confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from 2026 aggregator figures that mix USD and ARS with inconsistent conversions. Coffee and beer agree reasonably well across sources. The restaurant meal figures are weaker, and the cocktail and wine glass anchors are inferred from the local beer relationship because no reliable Mendoza cocktail price was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no accommodation search or live listings. The FX observation is the most recent one I could find in search (20 March 2026), which is older than the July 2026 pricing window and may not be the latest RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and café anchors use Mendoza-specific aggregator figures where available, cross-checked against 2026 Argentina-wide beer and cappuccino data. Cocktail is set at about 2.4 times the draft beer anchor, and wine glass is set as a discount to a typical Argentine restaurant glass, since Mendoza is a wine region. Accommodation is a model estimate based on general knowledge of Mendoza's lodging market relative to other Argentine provincial tourist cities, not on any searched listing.
